title: Problem
问题
html:
Visual instruction datasets contain unsupported objects and relations, so SFT can teach hallucination even when the model architecture is unchanged.

The paper's decision boundary is the released HalluciDoctor corrected visual instructions training object, not a model-only report or an evaluation-only benchmark. One record contains image, original instruction-response, hallucination diagnosis, and corrected response; its selection boundary is image-grounded object checks plus POPE/CHAIR-style hallucination evaluation, and the records are consumed by cleaned visual instruction SFT.

L4 facts: the official CVPR 2024 page, public records at https://drive.google.com/file/d/1M0dZwF6nPuZMLeAH44VhFj0RCS4KxL5D/view?usp=sharing, release scale and terms were checked on 2026-07-27. The paper is included because its central contribution directly constructs or curates serialized post-training targets.

视觉指令数据含有不存在的物体和关系，模型即使架构不变也会通过微调学到幻觉。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
HalluciDoctor diagnoses toxic records, identifies unsupported spans, rewrites them against image evidence, and releases corrected conversations for retraining. The closest comparison is unfiltered LLaVA-style instruction data and inference-only hallucination mitigation; unlike that neighbor, the primary object here is HalluciDoctor corrected visual instructions and the feedback boundary is image-grounded object checks plus POPE/CHAIR-style hallucination evaluation, which makes this an instruction/demonstration data paper rather than a model-architecture-only entry.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: existing visual instruction data audited for object and relation hallucinations. Operation: Normalize source identifiers, media or task inputs, and target fields into the release schema. Output and transition: Candidate records containing image, original instruction-response, hallucination diagnosis, and corrected response advance to target construction. Check / stop rule: Reject missing inputs, targets, or source provenance.

Step 2 - Write or transform the target. Input: The normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: multimodal teacher diagnoses unsupported content and rewrites affected answers produces or supplies the target while preserving fields needed for audit. Output and transition: A serialized instruction, demonstration, caption, rationale, or response advances to verification. Check / stop rule: A target that cannot be tied back to its input or source annotation is not retained.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated or transformed candidates. Operation: Apply image-grounded object checks plus POPE/CHAIR-style hallucination evaluation; deduplicate and assign release splits where documented. Output and transition: Passing records form about 50,000 diagnosis-and-rewrite visual instruction records stored as JSON conversations plus source image references and advance to training use. Check / stop rule: Keep only records that pass the stated correctness, grounding, format, or selection contract.

Step 4 - Consume the data. Input: The released records and the paper's chosen base model. Operation: Use them for cleaned visual instruction SFT and compare against unfiltered LLaVA-style instruction data and inference-only hallucination mitigation. Output and transition: A trained checkpoint and controlled evidence about the data intervention become the final evaluated artifacts. Check / stop rule: Judge both target-task quality and regression on general capabilities; no universal early-stopping threshold is disclosed.

Reproducibility requires pinning source revisions, the public manifest, transformation prompts, teacher version, filters, split, base checkpoint, and evaluation harness. The complete generation budget is not disclosed.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：论文核验过的公开任务、媒体、文档或已有指令来源。 操作：统一来源编号、输入和目标字段，并保留追踪信息。 输出及流转：候选记录进入目标构造阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少输入、目标或来源信息的记录直接删除。

步骤 2——撰写或转换目标。 输入：规范化候选及其来源证据。 操作：流程先诊断有毒记录和无依据片段，再依据图像改写答案，并公开修正对话用于重新训练。 输出及流转：得到包含 图像、原始指令回答、幻觉诊断以及修正回答 的结构化记录，并进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：不能回溯到输入、来源标注或生成轮次的目标不保留。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成或转换后的候选记录。 操作：按论文披露的正确性、执行结果、视觉落地、格式或质量信号筛选，并在有说明时去重和划分数据。 输出及流转：通过检查的 约 5 万条带诊断和改写的视觉指令记录 以 JSON 对话与来源图像引用 发布，随后进入训练。 检查与停止规则：只有满足论文接受契约且必需字段完整的记录进入发布集。

步骤 4——消费数据。 输入：公开记录与论文采用的基础模型。 操作：按论文配方完成指令微调、蒸馏或相应后训练，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的检查点和数据干预的受控证据成为最终评估产物。 检查与停止规则：同时检查目标任务质量和通用能力回退；论文未披露统一早停阈值时不得自行补写。

复现时需固定来源修订版、公开清单、转换提示、教师版本、过滤器、切分、基础检查点和评测工具。完整端到端生成预算若未披露，应保留为未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Training on corrected rather than original records reduces hallucination metrics while preserving general VQA performance; the controlled comparison changes the data diagnosis/rewrite stage.

Impact cross-check: OpenAlex reported 36 citations on 2026-07-27, and the official dataset exposes actual reusable records rather than only weights or examples. The count is an impact signal, not a Google Scholar citation line and not evidence that every record is correct.

在模型和训练设置不变时，用修正记录替换原记录可降低论文报告的幻觉指标，同时基本保留通用视觉问答表现。该对照支持数据诊断与改写，但不能证明诊断教师覆盖所有细微错误。

影响力交叉检查：OpenAlex 在 2026-07-27 报告 36 次引用，官方数据集也公开了可复用实际记录，而不是只有权重或样例。该数字只作为影响信号，不是 Google Scholar 引用数，也不能证明每条记录都正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work baseline: unfiltered LLaVA-style instruction data and inference-only hallucination mitigation. The actual change is treating hallucination as a repairable property of training records rather than only a decoding failure. This is a direction signal because it changes the serialized data object and its selection contract, not merely the backbone. The inherited model family, source tasks, autoregressive loss, and common benchmarks are not new. Before reuse, inspect teacher agreement can be mistaken for image-grounded correctness.
相对最近的共同做法，把视觉幻觉视为可在训练记录层面定位并修复的问题，而不只在解码阶段缓解。 这改变了可审计的数据对象或选择决策，而不只是更换骨干模型。继承的模型家族、自回归训练目标和常用评测并不新；复用前还要检查 教师一致意见可能被误当作真实图像依据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. The diagnosing teacher can miss subtle visual errors
  2. corrected prose may inherit one style
  3. source-image and LLaVA terms constrain redistribution.

1. 诊断教师可能漏掉细微视觉错误。
  2. 统一改写会引入新的表达风格偏差。
  3. 源图像和原始 LLaVA 数据条款限制再分发方式。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For auditing and repairing a visual SFT mixture before training, use the official manifest and schema to build a controlled SFT mixture. The output should be a versioned dataset and a fixed-backbone comparison; success requires the paper's task metrics plus an audit of teacher agreement can be mistaken for image-grounded correctness.
  • For data auditing, sample records across sources and reproduce the stated selection contract: image-grounded object checks plus POPE/CHAIR-style hallucination evaluation. Do not reuse the release when its licensing or source provenance cannot be preserved.

• 若要在训练前审计并修复视觉指令混合中的无依据回答，可复用官方清单、记录结构和论文披露的筛选配方。输出应是带版本的数据集与固定骨干对照；成功标准除论文指标外，还要审计 教师一致意见可能被误当作真实图像依据。
  • 数据审计者应跨来源抽样，复查必需字段、接受规则和许可。若无法保留来源信息或执行相同检查，就不应直接复用。
